cases.invariant: A staff viewer reaches the admin listings page and its listing summary columns
cases.response: page renders; the listings select contains premium_until and not listing_images
cases.testName: AdminListingsPage — listing summary columns (T9) [SEC-931-FE-PAGE-ALLOW] a staff viewer: selects premium_until for the dialogs and does not select listing_images

cases.invariant: A non-staff viewer is refused before the page reads any listing
cases.response: the page rejects with the not-found error
forbiddenEffects: any select on the admin client
cases.testName: AdminListingsPage — listing summary columns (T9) [SEC-931-FE-PAGE-DENY] a non-staff viewer is refused by requireStaffPage before any listings read

cases.invariant: A failed status change is shown as an error and does not change the row
forbiddenEffects: the row badge patched after a failed update
cases.testName: ListingPreviewDialog — status select (T4) [SEC-931-FE-STATUS-ERROR] a failed update toasts status_change_error and leaves the row unchanged

cases.invariant: A moderator holds a permission stored as allowed
cases.input: role_permissions row allowed:true on the admin client
forbiddenEffects: the user-scoped client used for role_permissions
cases.testName: hasPermission / assertPermission — moderator end-to-end [SEC-931-SRV-PERM-ALLOW] hasPermission → true for a moderator whose key is stored allowed:true (admin-client read)

cases.invariant: A viewer refused by requireViewer has no permission
cases.actor: Viewer refused as unauthenticated or lookup_failed
forbiddenEffects: a permission granted to a refused viewer
cases.testName: hasPermission / assertPermission — moderator end-to-end [SEC-931-SRV-PERM-DENY] a viewer refused by requireViewer has no permission and role_permissions is not read

cases.invariant: An administrator reads the moderator permission switches
cases.response: map of 13 keys reflecting the stored rows
forbiddenEffects: a key missing from the map
cases.testName: getModeratorPermissions [SEC-931-SRV-MODPERM-ALLOW] admin caller → result reflects the stored rows via the admin client; every other key false; 13 keys present

cases.invariant: A regular user cannot read the moderator permission switches
cases.testName: getModeratorPermissions [SEC-931-SRV-MODPERM-USER-DENY] regular user → rejects forbidden; admin client from(role_permissions) never called

cases.invariant: A moderator cannot read the moderator permission switches
forbiddenEffects: the switches returned to a moderator
cases.testName: getModeratorPermissions [SEC-931-SRV-MODPERM-MODERATOR-DENY] moderator → rejects forbidden; admin client from(role_permissions) never called

cases.invariant: A failed switch read grants nothing
forbiddenEffects: a true value after a failed read
cases.testName: getModeratorPermissions [SEC-931-SRV-MODPERM-ERROR] admin client read error → resolves to the all-false map; console.error called

cases.invariant: The Turnstile token is verified once, by Supabase Auth
cases.input: valid token, email and password; Supabase signUp succeeds
cases.response: { ok: true }; signUp received the token
cases.testName: signUpWithCaptcha — smoke tests (Task 441) [SEC-931-SRV-CAPTCHA-ALLOW] happy path: valid captcha + email/password → { ok: true }; the token goes to Supabase and verifyTurnstile is not called

cases.invariant: A captcha refused by Supabase Auth is a captcha failure
cases.testName: signUpWithCaptcha — smoke tests (Task 441) [SEC-931-SRV-CAPTCHA-DENY] captcha fail — Supabase refuses the token → { ok: false, reason: "captcha_failed" }

cases.invariant: An agent gets statistics access scoped to their own id
cases.response: { kind: ok, ownerId: the viewer id }
forbiddenEffects: an owner id other than the viewer id
cases.testName: getAgentStatisticsAccess [SEC-931-SRV-STATS-ALLOW] role agent -> ok with the session user id

cases.invariant: A failed role lookup never grants statistics access
forbiddenEffects: kind ok after a failed lookup
cases.testName: getAgentStatisticsAccess [SEC-931-SRV-STATS-DENY] a role lookup error is denied (not_agent), never granted

cases.invariant: An owner can mark their listing sold through the compare-and-set gateway
cases.input: listing active and owned by the actor; the update matches id and status
forbiddenEffects: a write without the status filter
cases.testName: gateway — applyListingTransitionByStatus (smoke) [SEC-931-SRV-TRANSITION-ALLOW] owner: active → sold (privileged) → { ok: true, nextStatus: "sold" }

cases.invariant: The paused expiry job only counts lapsed listings
cases.response: 200 with expired 0, would_expire 2 and their ids
cases.testName: POST /api/cron/listings-expiry [SEC-931-SRV-CRON-ALLOW] authorized, lapsed active listings → counted as would_expire, expired 0, no listing written

cases.invariant: Active listings without expiry are never written by the job
cases.input: three active rows with expires_at null
cases.testName: POST /api/cron/listings-expiry [SEC-931-SRV-CRON-DENY] NULL-expiry active rows reported but NOT mutated

cases.invariant: A failed read stops the job without a write
cases.input: the lapsed read returns an error
cases.testName: POST /api/cron/listings-expiry [SEC-931-SRV-CRON-ERROR] a failed read answers 500 read_failed and writes nothing
